readme: Display-only backup of the official redeem catalogue on 500.gov.tw, used by the Exercise Rewards iOS app when a vendor's intro page path cannot be recovered locally. Contains no personal data, no period UUIDs, no CSRF tokens, and deliberately no item ids: submitting a redemption always parses the live page, so nothing here can be sent back to the site. The live page is always authoritative - the site itself states that in-store notices take precedence over any published list, so treat this as a snapshot taken on capturedAt and show that date whenever this data is displayed.

fields.vendorName: Vendor name exactly as printed on the redeem page. Matched against the leading part of TaskPeriod.voucherSummary. Note that one vendor name itself contains a full-width slash, so never split the summary on it.
fields.introPath: Base-relative path of the vendor's catalogue page. Taken verbatim from the redeem page's link - never constructed from a vendor id.
fields.offers: The voucher plans offered for this vendor on the redeem page (what you choose between when redeeming).
fields.catalog: The products this vendor's voucher can be spent on, grouped as the intro page groups them. Absent until captured from a saved copy of the intro page.
